What You'll Feel

Barefoot massage.
Like two people
working on you.

Ashiatsu is massage performed with the feet — supported by overhead bars — delivering sustained, consistent pressure that hands simply cannot replicate. If you've spent years asking for deeper and never finding it, this is what you've been looking for.

"The deepest most comfortable pressure ever. 1st time doing this type of massage and I can't wait for my next one." — Matt Schram

Learn About Ashiatsu

What Makes This Different

Most massage treats where it hurts.
Nikki finds out why.

She reads the body, not just the complaint

Every session is a diagnostic conversation. Nikki looks for the fascial restriction, the structural imbalance, the compensatory pattern — not just the place that hurts.

"She reads your body and responds intuitively to what it needs. Doesn't chit chat — just gets to work." — Danielle P.

The deepest pressure you've ever felt

Ashiatsu barefoot massage delivers sustained, consistent pressure that hands cannot replicate. If you've never been able to find "deep enough" — this is what you've been looking for.

"The ashiatsu modality feels like you have 2 people giving you a massage!" — Danielle P.

Results that last

The goal is not to feel better until next week. Nikki sends every client home with customized stretches and exercises to support and extend the work done in session.

"Nikki has made it so that those symptoms are gone 95% of the time for me." — Adam

Services

Signature

Ashiatsu (Barefoot) Massage

The lead service. Barefoot pressure that reaches where hands stop. One of very few practitioners in Northern Michigan.

Learn more →

Deep Tissue Massage

Targeted work for chronic tension and overuse patterns. 13 years of knowing the difference between pressure and effective pressure.

Learn more →

Myofascial Release

For the tension you can feel but can't quite touch. Slow, specific work that unlocks what nothing else has reached.

Learn more →

Cupping Therapy

Lift instead of compress. Suction draws circulation into restricted areas and creates space that pressure alone cannot.

Learn more →

Gua Sha

Instrument-assisted fascial release that breaks down adhesions and restores tissue mobility.

Learn more →

Prenatal Massage

Therapeutic, safe, and supportive work for mothers-to-be. All products free of ingredients that could put you or your baby at risk.
